about:
Control mapping, edited in Distal > Settings > Control mapping. platforms.

.buttons: action -> physical button number (browser standard mapping: 0 bottom, 1 right, 2 left, 3 top face button, 4/5 bumpers, 6/7 triggers, 8 View, 9 Menu, 10/11 stick clicks, 12-15 D-pad up, down, left, right). keys: action -> keyboard code. schemes.defaults: the control scheme a build starts with (mouse, pad, touch, nostalgia) per build: web, touch (the web game on a touch-only device), windows, steamdeck; a player's own pick in Settings > Controls wins. schemes.nostalgia: the Nostalgia slide, speeds in ring radii per second (slow, soft = soft touch below, full = the max power set, over = how much faster gives the strongest power flick), aim = how much the slide angle bends the flick, wobble = spread from a wobbly slide.
